name: Jindal Saw Limited
revisionRemark: The revised shareholding is being uploaded due to an inadvertent error wherein Sigmatech Inc, a promoter & promoter group entity was classified as a public shareholder till 2018. Given that Sigmatech Inc was inadvertently classified as a public shareholder until 2018, and that the mandatory requirement of dematerialization of shares under SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements), 2015 is only for promoter group and not for public shareholders, the shares of Sigmatech Inc had not been dematerialized until the inadvertent error of classification was identified. However, the shares of Sigmatech Inc were forthwith dematerialized to ensure compliance with applicable laws, pursuant to the identification of the inadvertent error stated above

name: Jindal Saw Limited
remarksWeb: As per the provisions of circular no NSDL/Policy/2008/0018 dated March 24, 2008 issued by National Securities Depository Limited, if the trustees of a private trust are individuals, then the demat account can be opened in the name of Individual under the category of Individual. Accordingly, in the shareholding pattern for September 30, 2017, shares have been shown in the name of Mr. Sajjan Jindal under different PAN obtained by these trusts. However, Exchange has raised the discrepancy observed in the submission made for Shareholding Pattern for the quarter/Period ended 30-Sep-2017. Therefore, company has revised? the shareholding and add the name of Sajjan Jindal along with trust name.
